rationale: Pins the folder-namespace facts about a `+pkg/` file, which have NO textual construct in the grammar: the file's declaration is a PART OF the `mypkg` package (derived from the path the analyzer is handed), and the file is its own module, so it EXPORTS its primary declaration under the module-qualified name `mypkg.pkgfunc`. The module name and the declaration name differ by the package prefix, which is what makes the export row informative; a flat file whose module name equals its declaration would publish an X->X row and so publishes none (pinned by the forbid row on the flat fixtures' module identity).
